name: ICON MCP v101 MCP Server
description: Provides Model Context Protocol access to the ICON MCP v101 API with support for both Bearer token authentication and pay-per-use blockchain payments via the HTTP 402 protocol. It enables AI agents to interact with ICON API endpoints through standardized, asynchronous tools.

rawRecord.description: Provides Model Context Protocol access to the ICON MCP v101 API with support for both Bearer token authentication and pay-per-use blockchain payments via the HTTP 402 protocol. It enables AI agents to interact with ICON API endpoints through standardized, asynchronous tools.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Logging level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR).

D402_TESTING_MODE.description: Set to 'true' for local testing without settlement.

D402_FACILITATOR_URL.description: Facilitator service URL for the D402 protocol.

MCP_OPERATOR_ADDRESS.description: Operator's public address for verification (Required for Settlement in Production).

ICON_MCP_V101_API_KEY.description: Your ICON MCP v101 API key (required). Used for either direct authentication or as the server's internal key in payment mode.

D402_FACILITATOR_API_KEY.description: API key for a private facilitator service.

MCP_OPERATOR_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private key for signing settlement attestations (Required for Settlement in Production).
